'''2009 2K Event Day 1 John DellAngelo LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John DellAngelo]] at [[2009 2K Event]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Clarendox
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
